content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: runtime-prod-us-west-2 - elevated OOMs observed on route /v1/generate (approx 25/min). Pager fired for current oncall rotation. ticket=INC-2026-0423
sara: I'm on it. repro rate? any direct customer errors reported?
incident-bot: Customer impact: 7 failed requests in last 5m returning 503; 3 unique API keys affected. Attachments: sampled traces + log snippets. Severity: Sev2
james: seeing GPU fragmentation spikes on host gpu-4-2. OOMs when a single cudaMalloc ~2GB is requested. nvidia-smi shows ~14.7GB used / 16GB, but allocator map fragmented.
pranav: joining. paste runtime logs and dmesg? what's the route batching config?
james: route config: `batch_size: 32`, `max_tokens: 2048`, `kv_cache: enabled`, `prefetch: true`. runtime excerpt:
```
[2026-04-23T14:12:05Z] WARN oom_detected pid=3245 model=llama-2-13b variant=q8_0
[2026-04-23T14:12:05Z] ERROR cudaMalloc failed 2147483648 (2GB) -> OOM
[2026-04-23T14:12:05Z] INFO kvcache: eviction_count=18 latency_ms=2
[2026-04-23T14:12:05Z] DEBUG batcher: assembled_batch_size=28 sequences=12 tokens=842
```
pranav: batcher assembled 28 but only 12 sequences -> dynamic packing. KV evictions are happening but frees are small chunks; fragmentation hypothesis plausible.
lia: mem profiler shows lots of small transient allocations from attention kernels. Suggest immediate mitigation: cap `batch_size` to 16 for this route and flip kvcache eviction policy to aggressive to encourage coalescing.
sara: action item: reduce batch_size->16 and set `kvcache.eviction_policy=aggressive` for runtime-prod-us-west-2 on shard gpu-4-2. Who can push?
james: I'll roll a hotfix to the runtime config. starting canary deploy.
deploy-bot: deploy started by james -> runtime-config-hotfix-1994567890
deploy-bot: canary 1/3 succeeded, canary 2/3 started
pranav: while deploy runs, can someone upload `cudaMemGetInfo` and allocator map dumps to /tmp/oom-dumps/1994567890?
alia: uploaded /tmp/oom-dumps/1994567890/gpu-4-2-cuda-info.txt and allocator-map.json
```
cudaMemGetInfo: free=1.2GB total=16GB
allocator_map: free_regions: [128MB, 64MB, 32MB x3, 16MB x7], largest_free=128MB, fragmentation_score=0.72
```
pranav: fragmentation_score 0.72 is high. Hypothesis A: small/frequent KV cache allocations + attention transient allocations fragment heap leading to failure of large contiguous allocations.
Hypothesis B: background maintenance (tensor-copy / async-cpu-sync) intermittently pins buffers causing ephemeral reservations that further fragment the heap.
Evidence A: eviction_count spikes just before OOMs. Evidence B: background job logs show copy workers at 14:11:52 and 14:12:03 overlapping with OOM timestamps.
sara: mitigation plan in order: 1) cap batch_size to 16 (rolling now), 2) throttle background copy jobs for 5m, 3) consider startup preallocation of a large contiguous scratch buffer as temporary workaround.
james: canary 3/3 completed at 14:14:30 - config now active on all shards. monitoring metrics.
monitor-bot: ALERT cleared: OOM rate reduced from ~25/min to ~2/min in the last 5m.
pranav: good signal but keep collecting detailed traces for 30m and capture kvcache eviction logs per shard.
lia: pushed debug build to record free-list fragmentation per allocation step. logs streaming to s3://rw-runtime-debug/1994567890/allocator/
sara: customer impact update: most requests retried client-side; no persistent data loss. CS will reach out to any customers who saw persistent failures.
ben: FYI oncall handoff in 45m. If this persists we should evaluate moving the shard to a higher-memory instance or a host with larger contiguous memory as a medium-term mitigation.
pranav: RCA collection checklist: timeline of deploys & config changes, allocator maps pre/post OOMs, kvcache eviction rates, batcher assembly sizes, background job schedule, per-kernel allocation profiles.
sara: follow-ups: @pranav gather allocator & kernel traces, @james run controlled load tests with different packing/batch knobs, @lia add dashboard tile for fragmentation_score & largest_free_region, @ben estimate cost/impact of instance-type changes.
pranav: quick test idea: enable `kvcache.compact_on_eviction=true` (coalesce freed regions). Risk: added CPU overhead. Recommend enabling on single shard first.
james: I'll run compact_on_eviction on a dev shard and report perf/CPU impact.
sara: handoff to night oncall @ben in 45m unless OOMs spike again. Current status: mitigated -> monitor. Attaching logs and timeline to ticket INC-2026-0423.
ben: acknowledged. Ping me if OOMs exceed 5/min.
incident-bot: incident status updated: mitigated -> monitor. ticket=INC-2026-0423 last_event=1994569199
sara: thanks everyone. We'll run full RCA tomorrow with sample tracing, suggested patch plan, and preallocation/compaction experiments. Great catch on fragmentation patterns :thumbsup:
